targets.browser_support: Chrome or Edge with Web Serial
targets.summary: Full Hopspot build: Wi-Fi Auto, BLE Auto, LoRa, ESP-NOW, USB Auto.
steps: Choose the Heltec serial port from the browser prompt.
If the bootloader is not detected, hold BOOT, tap RESET, then release BOOT.
Wait for flash verification, then reset once and open the Hopspot SoftAP.

targets.browser_support: Chrome or Edge with Web Serial
targets.summary: ESP32-C6 Hopspot build: ESP-NOW, BLE Auto, USB Auto.
steps: Choose the XIAO ESP32-C6 serial port from the browser prompt.
If the bootloader is not detected, hold BOOT, tap RESET, then release BOOT.
Wait for flash verification, then reset once and reconnect over USB Auto.

targets.summary: nRF52840 UF2 Hopspot build: BLE Auto, LoRa, USB Auto.
steps: Double-tap RESET so the TECHOBOOT drive mounts.
Copy the UF2 artifact to TECHOBOOT.
The T-Echo reboots into the new firmware after the copy completes.
